description: A treated leather skin that holds enough water for a day's travel, slung easily from a belt or pack strap.
name: Waterskin
notes: Holds 5 drinks. Fill it in any town, or at the coast, in the swamp or by a forest stream.
In the Sunscorch Desert's daytime heat a drink keeps it off for two hours, and you drink from it by yourself when the heat comes due. A full skin sees you through one day's crossing.
